message: No detected input validation: The uploaded file is passed directly to pd.read_csv() inside read_file() with no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is acquired only via a user-uploaded file through Streamlit; no remote source is fetched, so no checksum, authentication, or integrity verification is present or applicable.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code reads a CSV file and applies SMOTE oversampling but performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The `load_prediction_models` function loads a serialized model via `joblib.load` without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before deserialization.
No detected label distribution validation: The code uses SMOTE for oversampling but performs no explicit class balance check or label distribution validation before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation-pattern analysis, trigger detection, or any other backdoor defense mechanism present in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing tools (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although train_test_split is imported, there is no evidence of held-out test set isolation from training data, signed/hashed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code reads CSV files and passes data directly to the model without any shape, range, type, or schema validation checks.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no checks on model output probabilities or predictions for NaN values, out-of-range probabilities, or threshold sanity before returning results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a tabular fraud-detection classifier (RandomForest/XGBoost/LightGBM), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
